title: Teaching Children as-Sidq (Truthfulness) and al-Amanah (Trustworthiness)
reference_info: حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين - عماد عبدالعظيم (الألوكة)

text_simplified: Parents must teach their children as-sidq (truthfulness) and al-amanah (trustworthiness) from a young age, for lying leads to major problems in the future. Moreover, tarbiyah (upbringing) based on Islamic values helps children build a strong and balanced personality. Parents should be a good example for their children in both speech and action.

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses the common word تربية (upbringing) without transliteration; the English adds 'tarbiyah' and parentheses, making the text more technical and less warm/direct than the source.
